_comment: Hand-written demo fixture, matched to the scripted input in docs/demo-script.md. Not model output — tuned by hand so the reveal lands exactly as intended. Replace with a recorded live response once the prompt is tuned.

profile.summary: a two-person bakery in Bandra taking custom cake orders over Instagram
profile._industryNote: Titan's 16-industry taxonomy, which api/profile.ts constrains the model to. Was 'Bakery & confectionery' - a label matching neither Titan's taxonomy nor Neo's builder categories, so the handoff URL never carried an industryKey. See docs/data-findings.md section 6.

_nextQuestionIdNote: The model's suggestion for what to ask first. The engine overrules it if the signal is already resolved, so this can never break the flow. 'channel' is chosen here because the free text already mentions Instagram — asking it back makes the tool look like it was listening.

reveal._domainsNote: Availability and price are overridden at runtime by the live DomScan lookup (/api/domains). These values are the FALLBACK shown only when that call fails. They are set to the measured live figures rather than invented ones, so the fallback path can never contradict the happy path in front of an audience. The stem must match domainStem above — the lookup keys off it.
